headline: Analogue unveils upgraded Super Nt and Mega Sg retro consoles
summary: Analogue announced upgraded versions of its Super Nt and Mega Sg retro consoles, featuring a reworked industrial design and built-in wireless connectivity for controllers and accessories, while still playing original Nintendo and Sega Genesis cartridges via an FPGA processor.

claims.statement: Analogue announced new, upgraded versions of its Super Nt and Mega Sg retro consoles.

sources.quote: Analogue is re-releasing its SNES and Genesis consoles with some nice upgrades
Analogue returns to the 16-bit era with the Mega Sg+ and Super Nt+

claims.statement: The new versions feature a reworked industrial design and built-in wireless connectivity for controllers and accessories.

sources.quote: a "reworked industrial design" and built-in wireless connectivity for controllers and accessories.

claims.statement: Like the originals, the new consoles can play original Nintendo and Sega Genesis cartridges using an FPGA processor.
